space.name: Government-Wide Administrative Systems
space.description: The space of every possible government-wide administrative system - the cross-government coordinating layer over heterogeneous agency administrations, and every configuration it could take. Each reference system below is a coordinate frame over this space: independent axes, each with an exhaustive value set, so that assigning one value per axis locates any concrete system.

meta.description: A collection of reference systems (coordinate frames) for the space of government-wide administrative systems. Each frame is a set of independent axes with exhaustive value sets; assigning every axis a value gives the coordinates of a system. Frames name no subsets - administrative models and typologies are deliberately excluded.

systems.name: submodel
systems.title: Submodel Characterisation Frame
systems.description: The note's own characterisation system: an orthogonal decomposition of a well-functioning government-wide administration into 23 submodels, each carrying the dimensions that locate a system within its domain.
systems.frame_basis: Functional submodel decomposition, optimised for comprehensive coverage and orthogonality.
